meta.name: Honeymoon Photographer
meta.description: Newlyweds Adhir and Zoya Irani's Maldives trip turns tragic when Adhir's body is found buried on a beach. Suspicion falls on their friends, family, and Zoya herself as the investigation unfolds.

videos.title: The Honeymoon
videos.overview: Fleeing a media scandal surrounding Irani Pharma, Adhir and Zoya escape for their honeymoon, accompanied by their photographer, Ambika. But their retreat takes a strange turn with the arrival of a mysterious stranger, culminating in a body washing up on the beach.

videos.title: Suspect No. 1
videos.overview: After Adhir's mysterious death, his powerful parents suspect foul play and bring in relentless cop Divya Sawant to investigate. As she delves into the case, dark secrets emerge, positioning Ambika as the prime suspect in a growing web of lies and conspiracy.

videos.title: Nowhere to Hide
videos.overview: On the run with nowhere to hide, Ambika unexpectedly finds an ally in Elvin. Together, they begin to unravel the dark secrets that Zoya and the Iranis are desperately concealing. But the closer they get to the truth, the more dangerous their path becomes.

videos.title: Secrets Tumble Out
videos.overview: Ambika faces the enigmatic stranger from her honeymoon once more, threatening to reveal a secret that could save her. They forge a reluctant alliance to uncover critical evidence and uncover the truth.

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: With the cops closing in, Ambika's bid to clear her name using the evidence backfires, thrusting her into a high-stakes scramble for an unexpected and perilous solution.

videos.title: Case Closed
videos.overview: In the season finale, Ambika executes her daring final plan to clear her name. As the dust settles, true colors emerge, revealing that no one is safe!
